mapper.update: UPDATE Alltotle a JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_1, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_2, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_3, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_4, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_5, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_6, CONCAT(SUM(CASE WHEN fenlei = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), '个') AS fenlei_7 FROM sci_jiaocairuanzhu WHERE state = 6 GROUP BY user_id ) AS stats ON a.userId = stats.user_id SET a.cbzz1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_1, 0), a.cbzz2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_2, 0), a.cbyz1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_3, 0), a.cbyz2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_4, 0), a.cbjc1 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_5, 0), a.cbjc2 = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_6, 0), a.zbjc = COALESCE(stats.fenlei_7, 0)
